signin.title: Who are you?
signin.hint: Enter your name once. It's remembered in this browser for both your passenger and driver pages.
signin.demoHint: This is a demo: please use a made-up name. Other visitors see it next to your drives, and anyone who enters the same name sees your searches.
browse.title: Upcoming rides
browse.limited: Showing the next {count} rides. To find one for your trip, use Find a ride on the Passenger page.
form.pickerHint: Type an address to search, or click "Pick on map" then click a point on the map.
ride.title: Find a ride
ride.radiusHint: Drivers whose route passes through both circles on the map. Wider circles find more rides; you get to the pickup and from the drop-off on foot or by public transport.
ride.matchesHint: Click a match to see its route on the map.
ride.askHint: Nothing that suits you? Ask the drivers who often make this trip. A few of them are told, and your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSent.one: Request sent: {count} driver who has made this trip was told. Your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSent.other: Request sent: {count} drivers who have made this trip were told. Your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSentNone: Request sent. No driver has made this trip recently, but your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.requestsEmpty: No open requests. After a search, you can ask drivers for a ride nobody has posted.
ride.recentEmpty: Your searches will show up here.
ride.recentItem: Searched for {time} · click to search again
ride.needTime: Choose when you want to travel.
ride.noMatches: No drivers found. Try wider circles or more flexibility on the time.
ride.noMatchesInside: No drivers within your circles and time flexibility.
ride.outsideHint: These don't fit everything you selected, but might suit you anyway.
ride.noTransit: No direct public transport option found.
drive.title: Your drives
drive.empty: You have no upcoming drives. Offer one below.
inbox.title: Inbox

inbox.done.mute: You won't hear about this route again.

inbox.paused: You didn't answer the last few requests, so we've paused them until {date}.
inbox.notifyRequests: Tell me when a passenger asks for a ride on a route I've driven
